name: bdigital-public
description: Claude Code plugins distributed alongside the bdigital media engineering blog. Self-contained, MIT-licensed, and tied to a specific published walkthrough.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: User-invocable skill that generates a distilled brief so a fresh Claude Code session can resume where the previous one left off. Implements the 'Clear with a brief' pattern from Anthropic's session management guide.

plugins.name: cc-context-monitor
plugins.description: User-invocable skill that configures an info-dense Claude Code statusline: cwd, git branch with dirty flag, model label, and three color-banded 10-dot progress bars for context window fill, 5-hour session rate-limit burn, and 7-day weekly quota burn — all read natively from CC's stdin payload.

plugins.name: cursor-team-kit
plugins.description: Claude Code port of Cursor's team-kit plugin — 16 skills + 2 subagents for CI loops, PR review, shipping, verification, CLI/UI control, code-quality audits, and weekly work summaries. Original by Team Cursor (plugins@cursor.com), MIT-licensed; ported and maintained by bdigital media with full attribution. See the plugin's PORTING-NOTES.md for the per-file cursor → Claude Code adaptation log.
